description: Quant setup performance. Panels filter on setup_type; Grafana labels use the PM/DE product_key lock: sweep_reclaim→1_liquidity_sweep_vwap_reclaim, fvg_entry→2_fvg_mitigation_vwap, po3_judas→3_po3_asia_range_sweep, mss_break→4_pending_user_confirm, order_block→5_pending_user_confirm, sweep_mss→6_pending_user_confirm. Setups 4–6 entry rules are pending user confirm — do not invent them. No live trading.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(win_rate) AS win_rate FROM signal_performance WHERE setup_type IN (${setup_type:sqlstring}) AND day >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND n_closed > 0
SELECT AVG(avg_rr) AS avg_rr FROM signal_performance WHERE setup_type IN (${setup_type:sqlstring}) AND day >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND n_closed > 0
SELECT SUM(n_signals) AS n FROM signal_performance WHERE setup_type IN (${setup_type:sqlstring}) AND day >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT SUM(pnl) AS pnl FROM signal_performance WHERE setup_type IN (${setup_type:sqlstring}) AND day >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

SELECT day AS time, CASE setup_type WHEN 'sweep_reclaim' THEN '1_liquidity_sweep_vwap_reclaim' WHEN 'fvg_entry' THEN '2_fvg_mitigation_vwap' WHEN 'po3_judas' THEN '3_po3_asia_range_sweep' WHEN 'mss_break' THEN '4_pending_user_confirm' WHEN 'order_block' THEN '5_pending_user_confirm' WHEN 'sweep_mss' THEN '6_pending_user_confirm' ELSE setup_type END AS metric, n_signals AS value FROM signal_performance WHERE setup_type IN (${setup_type:sqlstring}) AND day >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY 1

SELECT day AS time, CASE setup_type WHEN 'sweep_reclaim' THEN '1_liquidity_sweep_vwap_reclaim' WHEN 'fvg_entry' THEN '2_fvg_mitigation_vwap' WHEN 'po3_judas' THEN '3_po3_asia_range_sweep' WHEN 'mss_break' THEN '4_pending_user_confirm' WHEN 'order_block' THEN '5_pending_user_confirm' WHEN 'sweep_mss' THEN '6_pending_user_confirm' ELSE setup_type END AS metric, win_rate AS value FROM signal_performance WHERE setup_type IN (${setup_type:sqlstring}) AND day >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY 1

SELECT day AS time, CASE setup_type WHEN 'sweep_reclaim' THEN '1_liquidity_sweep_vwap_reclaim' WHEN 'fvg_entry' THEN '2_fvg_mitigation_vwap' WHEN 'po3_judas' THEN '3_po3_asia_range_sweep' WHEN 'mss_break' THEN '4_pending_user_confirm' WHEN 'order_block' THEN '5_pending_user_confirm' WHEN 'sweep_mss' THEN '6_pending_user_confirm' ELSE setup_type END AS metric, avg_rr AS value FROM signal_performance WHERE setup_type IN (${setup_type:sqlstring}) AND day >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY 1

SELECT day AS time, CASE setup_type WHEN 'sweep_reclaim' THEN '1_liquidity_sweep_vwap_reclaim' WHEN 'fvg_entry' THEN '2_fvg_mitigation_vwap' WHEN 'po3_judas' THEN '3_po3_asia_range_sweep' WHEN 'mss_break' THEN '4_pending_user_confirm' WHEN 'order_block' THEN '5_pending_user_confirm' WHEN 'sweep_mss' THEN '6_pending_user_confirm' ELSE setup_type END AS metric, SUM(SUM(pnl)) OVER (PARTITION BY setup_type ORDER BY day) AS value FROM signal_performance WHERE setup_type IN (${setup_type:sqlstring}) GROUP BY day, setup_type ORDER BY 1

WITH locked(setup_type, product_key) AS (VALUES ('sweep_reclaim','1_liquidity_sweep_vwap_reclaim'),('fvg_entry','2_fvg_mitigation_vwap'),('po3_judas','3_po3_asia_range_sweep'),('mss_break','4_pending_user_confirm'),('order_block','5_pending_user_confirm'),('sweep_mss','6_pending_user_confirm')) SELECT l.setup_type, l.product_key, COALESCE(SUM(p.n_signals), 0) AS n_signals, COALESCE(AVG(p.win_rate), 0) AS win_rate, COALESCE(AVG(p.avg_rr), 0) AS avg_realized_r FROM locked l LEFT JOIN signal_performance p ON p.setup_type = l.setup_type AND p.day >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE l.setup_type IN (${setup_type:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
